name: all
comments: Each participant signed informed written consent for the study and underwent a screening procedure including a medical history, physical examination, electrocardiography and routine hematologic, biochemical and serologic tests confirming good health. None of the individuals had a history of drug or alcohol abuse and cardiovascular disorders. Subjects with a Q interval of more than 220 ms, a heart rate of less than 55 min_x0002_1 at rest, a systolic blood pressure of less than 120 mmHg in the lying position were not recruited.

name: all
comments: Taking additional drugs or dietary supplements was not allowed one month prior to and during the study period.

name: all
comments: All subjects were asked to abstain from alcohol- and caffeine-containing products and to keep a low-flavonoid diet by avoiding a defined list of food and beverages (apples, fruit juices, onions, berries, beans, kale etc.) one week prior to the study until its conclusion.
